_regen_soldat_: Day 10. The corporal put Arno Soldat beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Arno Soldat sorted the dressings by lamplight. When the next stretcher arrived, he could find everything without looking. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Arno Soldat folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Arno Soldat held the mirror while Oskar Mccarter shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
Arno Soldat bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.
Arno Soldat practised asking for bread in the local language. The dugout supplied an audience and several confidently incorrect pronunciations.
Rain blew in under the dugout door. Arno Soldat moved his boots out of the wet, then realized they were already inside.
Valentin Gtdigo (Concord) threw a loaf of bread into the Hegemony trench at the Chalk Pits. An hour later a sausage came back with a note from Arno Soldat: 'Fair trade.'
A local carter understood Arno Soldat's request for bread, then explained that the same sentence sounded very much like a request for a beard.
alexandremilon2: The sergeant gave Ulrich Alexandremil a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 10 or any other.

Lucien "Brick" Yuas and Ulrich Alexandremil carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Ulrich Alexandremil watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Ulrich Alexandremil took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at P-F10, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Viktor "Bones" Jcortes of the Hegemony (@jcortes_1366). Ulrich Alexandremil was killed at P-F10 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Viktor "Bones" Jcortes of the Hegemony (@jcortes_1366).
The House of Alexandremil sent another. Zeno Alexandremil, uncle of Ulrich Alexandremil, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
The patrol came back one man at a time. Zeno Alexandremil held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone.
Zeno Alexandremil saw a hare run the whole length of no man's land and nobody on either side fired at it.
The aid post ran out of morphine at four. Zeno Alexandremil held a boy's hand until six. Then he went back for the next one.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Zeno Alexandremil closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
Fog hid the far end of P-F10. Zeno Alexandremil kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout.
beaucookie13: Zeno Beaucookie was a ferryman in Belmonte until the posters went up. He came to T-F16 with a pressed cornflower, and within a day the whole squad knew that he whistles the same four notes over and over.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-F16 with the rations. Zeno Beaucookie ate while listening to the revised orders.

A bullet grazed Zeno Beaucookie's ribs at T-F16. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Tobias Cermitboy of the Hegemony (@cermitboy). The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In T-F16, Zeno Beaucookie listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Zeno Beaucookie walked back up the communication trench to T-F16, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Zeno Beaucookie kept Ivo Jeff awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Zeno could have walked there blind.
Zeno Beaucookie spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.
Zeno Beaucookie sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line.

Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Zeno Beaucookie only heard boots on the duckboards at T-F16, then nothing but pain. Raider: Isidor "Doc" Slick of the Hegemony (@baron_von_slick). Zeno Beaucookie died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
The papers connected Teodor Beaucookie to Zeno Beaucookie. The men took longer to learn Teodor Beaucookie's own habits, but they made the effort.

Teodor Beaucookie felt a hard tug at his hip at T-F16. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Emil Marshman of the Hegemony (@asa_marshman).
dennisth3_menac: The draft reached V-F10 on Day 11. Silas Menac was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore. Grey Mill is lost. Silas Menac heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Quentin "Saint" Jankiedestro and Silas Menac split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.
Silas Menac kept Severin Montalvao awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Silas could have walked there blind.
Silas Menac sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
Silas Menac tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Silas Menac was hit hard in the fight at V-F10 before anyone could fire. The raider was Isidor Hansell of the Hegemony. Raider: Isidor Hansell of the Hegemony (@just_hansell19).
Silas Menac's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at V-F10 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
felipe.barba11: Rafael "Spark" Barba reached U-F7 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Rafael "Spark" Barba was made Lance Corporal. He celebrated by sleeping four hours in a row. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Rafael "Spark" Barba kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Rafael "Spark" Barba was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at U-F7. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Walter Bengal of the Hegemony (@propaganda_of_bengal).
The wound on Rafael "Spark" Barba's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
A bullet went through Rafael "Spark" Barba's sleeve at U-F7 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Gideon "Brick" Donathanpanc of the Hegemony (@donathanpanchothethird).

Rafael "Spark" Barba was carrying water up to U-F7 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Rafael "Spark" Barba did not. Shot by Yann "Doc" Slayer of the Hegemony (@coffee_slayer).
Fever took hold of Rafael "Spark" Barba overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Rafael "Spark" Barba died waiting. The men at U-F7 have not stopped talking about it.
The papers say Hugo "Owl" Barba. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Rafael "Spark" Barba's eyes. Nobody in U-F7 argues.
flying_wizzerd: Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd came up with a draft of replacements on Day 6. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.' Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd was invited to the Officers' Mess for keeping the front supplied. The colonel poured a real coffee and raised his cup: 'The front does not forget its friends.'

Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd and Hugo Adamjedlicka both swear they saw a ghost at Blackwater Canal. Each says the other screamed first. A letter from home found Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd before the night shift. Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd folded it small and kept it close.

Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line. A letter from home found Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd before the night shift. Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd folded it small and kept it close.

Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd landed next to Dietrich Dilloncoll in the Hegemony trench. Only Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd climbed back out. (@dilloncoll2015) Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Jakub Virajvirxgil was down and screaming for a medic. (@virajvirxgill13) Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd was on watch at R-S12 when the night raid hit. The men found Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Viktor Newnario of the Hegemony (@newnario).

Another member of the House of Wizzerd reached the line: Bastian Wizzerd. He asked where Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd had slept, then chose a different corner. Bastian Wizzerd reported for duty as a sniper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

Bastian Wizzerd measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together. A letter from home found Bastian Wizzerd before the night shift. Bastian Wizzerd folded it small and kept it close. The major nailed Bastian Wizzerd's posters to every dugout door and had the words read out at the dawn watch. From today Bastian Wizzerd is the Propagandist of the Concord. The rifle stays too. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Bastian Wizzerd is number 460. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Bastian Wizzerd kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand. Bastian Wizzerd found a muddy Jack Russell terrier shivering under a duckboard and shared his bread. Now the dog follows him everywhere. Bastian Wizzerd calls it Socks.
Across from R-S12, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Bastian Wizzerd saw it. Gustav Ethanlam was grazed.

Bastian Wizzerd hauled ammunition boxes up the communication trench all night. His back filed a formal complaint. A letter from home found Bastian Wizzerd before the night shift. Bastian Wizzerd folded it small and kept it close.

Bastian Wizzerd got a letter from Elias. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. A letter from home found Bastian Wizzerd before the night shift. Bastian Wizzerd folded it small and kept it close.
Bastian Wizzerd wrote back to Elias and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.

Bastian Wizzerd went over with the raiders and dropped into the Hegemony trench. Ivo Sedlomancz was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@sedlomancz) Bastian Wizzerd jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Ulrich Asher. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@asher_g5) On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Bastian Wizzerd was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire.
Bastian Wizzerd spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
jackwshannen: The new rifleman is Jonas Jackwshannen, once a tailor from Halden. The corporal asked if a tailor was any use in a trench. Jonas Jackwshannen said he would find out.

Jonas Jackwshannen opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first. Jonas Jackwshannen got a letter with a pressed leaf from the tree by the front door at home.

Jonas Jackwshannen found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a wedding party, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire. A short letter reached Jonas Jackwshannen: everyone is well, the dog misses you. Jonas Jackwshannen read the part about the dog twice.
johannmigano: "You're late," said the corporal when Otto Johannmigano arrived on Day 5. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Otto Johannmigano found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. Day 6: Hill 304 was lost. Otto Johannmigano wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Otto Johannmigano raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F1. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Ulrich Seths of the Hegemony (@seths110).
Otto Johannmigano no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Otto Johannmigano reached up to fix a sandbag at R-F1 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Jonas Solyommadar of the Hegemony (@solyommadar11).

Otto Johannmigano was hit through the chest at R-F1. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Ulrich Seths of the Hegemony (@seths110). Otto Johannmigano stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-F1. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Ulrich Seths of the Hegemony (@seths110).
Another member of the House of Johannmigano reached the line: Gustav Johannmigano. He asked where Otto Johannmigano had slept, then chose a different corner.
The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At R-F1 they left Gustav Johannmigano behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Silas Zeaglermkt of the Hegemony (@zeaglermkt).
The House of Johannmigano sent another. Karel "Ash" Johannmigano, brother of Gustav Johannmigano, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.

Karel "Ash" Johannmigano fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Jonas Solyommadar was badly wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight. Karel "Ash" Johannmigano got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 335. The men who came later will ask about it. After the loss of Grey Mill, Karel "Ash" Johannmigano helped stack spare sandbags at R-F1. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Karel "Ash" Johannmigano fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Konrad Embersky was grazed. Karel "Ash" Johannmigano ate breakfast without a word.
Karel "Ash" Johannmigano read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
A flare lit the Bone Quarry like noon. Karel "Ash" Johannmigano counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.

Karel "Ash" Johannmigano had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Marek "Lucky" Ronnnie was badly wounded. A shell burst over R-F1 and threw Karel "Ash" Johannmigano into the side of the trench. Cuts, bruises, ringing ears. He stayed at his post.
Karel "Ash" Johannmigano came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.

Machine-gun fire swept R-F1. Karel "Ash" Johannmigano took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Nils Lettersupona of the Hegemony (@lettersuponashes).
jorj_costava: The draft reached Q-F19 on Day 9. Nils Costava was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Nils Costava wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A note came over the wire at the Chalk Pits, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Concord. Signed, Quentin Nieuwenhuis.' Nils Costava sang louder. Grey Mill is lost. Nils Costava heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Nils Costava's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
A second spoon disappeared. Nils Costava searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.
Nils Costava lifted the board. The gap contained seven spoons, a button and a pencil people had blamed the quartermaster for losing.
Nils Costava carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.
Nils Costava was carrying water up to Q-F19 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Nils Costava did not. Shot by Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto of the Hegemony (@chiaroveto).
Nils Costava's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed.
jpateman_: After 15 days of war, V-F5 had a place for everything. On Day 15, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Otto Jpateman.

Otto Jpateman traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not. The letter for Otto Jpateman had a few coins taped inside. They would buy almost nothing here, but Otto Jpateman kept them.

Quentin Oconnor (Concord) and Otto Jpateman (Hegemony) were sent out to cut the other side's wire at the Drowned Farm on the same night. They met in the middle and agreed to go home. A thin letter reached Otto Jpateman. Only five lines long, and Otto Jpateman knew every one of them by heart before supper.
lasse13652: The old hands of S-C11 have been here since Day 1. Oskar Lasse has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Oskar Lasse kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Oskar Lasse gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page. Oskar Lasse got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 703. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Oskar Lasse watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Oskar Lasse was found at the bottom of the trench at S-C11, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Albin "Whistle" Gossett of the Hegemony (@zach_gossett). Oskar Lasse was killed at S-C11 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Albin "Whistle" Gossett of the Hegemony (@zach_gossett).
The House of Lasse sent Jonas "Bones" Lasse after Oskar Lasse. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Jonas "Bones" Lasse won before reaching the end of his entry.
Jonas "Bones" Lasse found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.
At Saint-Ash crossroads, Jonas "Bones" Lasse and Severin Time exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.
Jonas "Bones" Lasse of the Concord and Bram Somosmagios of the Hegemony have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at Grey Mill. It is getting crowded.
A crow sat on the parapet above Jonas "Bones" Lasse all afternoon. The men say it chose him.
leonardo_boninelli: Anselm Boninelli arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a frozen apple and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Anselm Boninelli's hands still remember being a ferryman's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world. A letter reached Anselm Boninelli with a child's drawing of a soldier. The soldier in the drawing was smiling. Anselm Boninelli tried to as well.
A bullet went through Anselm Boninelli's sleeve at N-F19 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Lucien "Hollow" Moonroleen of the Concord (@moonroleen).
leothebeo8: Norbert "Mud" Leothebeo came up on Day 9 carrying news from Greyhallow. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Henrik "Lucky" Carterdelaru, grazed. Norbert "Mud" Leothebeo cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Norbert "Mud" Leothebeo watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

A parcel from home held a comb. Norbert "Mud" Leothebeo has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Norbert "Mud" Leothebeo is number 712. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Norbert "Mud" Leothebeo read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Norbert "Mud" Leothebeo aimed a step ahead and fired: Tobias Kowalien, grazed.

Shell splinters caught Norbert "Mud" Leothebeo in the chest and belly at S-C14. The medic worked with both hands and shouted for a bed. At S-C14 a shell hit the exact spot where Norbert "Mud" Leothebeo was standing. The trench wall there is gone, and so is Norbert "Mud" Leothebeo.
Karel Leothebeo came to the front because his cousin Norbert "Mud" Leothebeo never came home. He carries a bullet that missed him.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Karel Leothebeo fired, and Florian "Button" Thebaileebla was grazed.
Karel Leothebeo fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Marek "Parson" Donaldgregor was grazed.
Karel Leothebeo fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
The sergeant at S-C14 called out a range and a spot. Karel Leothebeo was the only one who hit it. Hugo Noobly was grazed.
lucas.canales55: Teodor Canales came up on Day 10 carrying news from Oakmere. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Teodor Canales was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at P-F14. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Ivo Ursarte of the Concord (@not_ursarte). Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Teodor Canales watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

A bullet found Teodor Canales at P-F14, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Oskar Ohl of the Concord (@mika__ohl). Teodor Canales was killed at P-F14 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Oskar Ohl of the Concord (@mika__ohl).
Dorian "Spark" Canales had heard about Teodor Canales's courage. At P-F14, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Dorian "Spark" Canales (Hegemony) and Edmund Fisher (Concord) were sent out to cut the other side's wire at Saint-Ash crossroads on the same night. They met in the middle and agreed to go home. A letter from home reached Dorian "Spark" Canales before dusk. Dorian "Spark" Canales read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian "Spark" Canales spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection. A letter from home reached Dorian "Spark" Canales before dusk. Dorian "Spark" Canales read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dawn watch. Dorian "Spark" Canales put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Jakub Thedukeofvel, gravely wounded. A bullet hit Dorian "Spark" Canales in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at P-F14. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Ivo Ursarte of the Concord (@not_ursarte). A letter from home reached Dorian "Spark" Canales before dusk. Dorian "Spark" Canales read it twice and slept a little easier.

A medic brought Dorian "Spark" Canales half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real. The letter for Dorian "Spark" Canales was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Dorian "Spark" Canales liked the crossed-out parts best.
The medics would not give up on Dorian "Spark" Canales. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to P-F14 today.
markdavis76239: On the way to R-S8, Walter Markdavis tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way. Walter Markdavis's transfer to the role of chaplain was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Walter Markdavis worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost. A letter from home found Walter Markdavis before the night shift. Walter Markdavis folded it small and kept it close.
Walter Markdavis traded a tin whistle for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.

Walter Markdavis kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it. A letter from home found Walter Markdavis before the night shift. Walter Markdavis folded it small and kept it close.
Walter Markdavis and Cyril "Mud" Sann carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-S8. Walter Markdavis has learned to walk bent double.

Walter Markdavis thought about a wife and a daughter he has never met on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter. A letter from home found Walter Markdavis before the night shift. Walter Markdavis folded it small and kept it close. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Walter Markdavis is number 388. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is lost. Walter Markdavis heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
A man asked Walter Markdavis to sit nearby without saying anything. He stayed until the man fell asleep.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Walter Markdavis shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Arno Ali, was gravely wounded. A letter from home found Walter Markdavis before the night shift. Walter Markdavis folded it small and kept it close.

Walter Markdavis held a service in a shell hole. Eleven men came. Two of them had never prayed before. Both of them asked for another. A letter from home found Walter Markdavis before the night shift. Walter Markdavis folded it small and kept it close.

Walter Markdavis saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work. A letter from home found Walter Markdavis before the night shift. Walter Markdavis folded it small and kept it close.

Walter Markdavis's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket. There was a letter for Walter Markdavis and a little tobacco folded inside. The tobacco went round the squad. The letter did not.

Walter Markdavis cut Casimir Zksoon's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. The letter for Walter Markdavis asked if the food was good. Walter Markdavis wrote back that it was. That was a lie, but a kind one.
marksebastion: Gustav Marksebastio arrived at R-F5 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

The barrage caught Gustav Marksebastio in the open at R-F5. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. Gustav Marksebastio finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept.
Gustav Marksebastio is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger.

Gustav Marksebastio spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Gustav Marksebastio did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
There was never a bed for Gustav Marksebastio, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-F5 on his own feet.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Gustav Marksebastio ate two helpings anyway.
A muddy dog crawled into R-F5 through the wire. Gustav Marksebastio gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Lump.
Fresh from training, Gustav Marksebastio still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Isidor "Mole" Raptor, badly wounded.

A clear shot from R-F5. Gustav Marksebastio grazed Tobias Htmmci and slid back down below the parapet. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Gustav Marksebastio watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Gustav Marksebastio fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Casimir "Lucky" Localfilipin was badly wounded. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Gustav Marksebastio answered to number 218. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Gustav Marksebastio wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Gustav Marksebastio has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Viktor Rockytheauti, gravely wounded.
Lump has learned to carry messages in a tin on its collar. Gustav Marksebastio is very proud. Lump is mainly proud of the biscuits.
Gustav Marksebastio agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Gustav Marksebastio fired, and Pavel Rozzyadog was badly wounded.

In the dark of the Concord trench Gustav Marksebastio hit Tobias "Smokes" Chris with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@mightbe_chris) Gustav Marksebastio jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Zeno Sharky. The Concord medics will be busy. (@just_sharky24) Back from the raid, Gustav Marksebastio found a sweetheart card in a coat pocket that was not there before: 'Sunday' (common). Nobody asked where it came from.
Gustav Marksebastio was hit in the foot through his boot at R-F5. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Felix Bubik of the Concord (@bubik_233).
mathias92618: In Tannenfeld, Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias was a tailor. In S-S12, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a tailor again.

The aid post ran out of morphine at four. Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias held a boy's hand until six. Then he went back for the next one. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias. Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Zeno Retarded and Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.

Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias carried three men out of S-S12 on a stretcher. One of them thanked him. Two could not. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias. Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias. Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A patient apologized for bleeding on Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias's sleeve. He told the patient to concentrate on staying awake. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias. Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias answered to number 446. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at S-S12 changed before the cheering ended. Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias shouldered another load.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias's ear at S-S12 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Rafael Warhamster of the Concord (@warhamster4).
The wound on Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias and Hugo Mrcakerson both swear they saw a ghost at the Brickworks. Each says the other screamed first.
Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters. Today, under fire at the Hanging Bridge, that habit was the only steady thing in S-S12.
Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias and Hugo Mrcakerson made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.
The corporal found out Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias used to be a tailor. Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias has been doing two jobs ever since.
mazdarati_bo: The new stretcher bearer is Anselm Mazdarati, once a coal miner from Saint-Lune. The corporal asked if a coal miner was any use in a trench. Anselm Mazdarati said he would find out.

Benedikt Slothc drew a map of Anselm Mazdarati's hometown from Anselm's stories. Anselm says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere. A letter from home reached Anselm Mazdarati before dusk. Anselm Mazdarati read it twice and slept a little easier. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Anselm Mazdarati wrote to a grandmother who prays for both armies that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Anselm Mazdarati warmed the ink bottle inside his tunic. The letter began only when the ink agreed to move.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Anselm Mazdarati helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.

Anselm Mazdarati began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else. A letter from home reached Anselm Mazdarati before dusk. Anselm Mazdarati read it twice and slept a little easier.
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Anselm Mazdarati waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.

Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy of the Hegemony shouted across the wire at the Bone Quarry, asking for the football scores from home. Anselm Mazdarati of the Concord shouted them back. Some of them were even true. The letter for Anselm Mazdarati ended with 'come home soon'. Anselm Mazdarati read the last line more than the rest.

Word of Anselm Mazdarati's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation. A letter reached Anselm Mazdarati with a child's drawing of a soldier. The soldier in the drawing was smiling. Anselm Mazdarati tried to as well.
noamorax: Day 10: Dorian Noamorax reached Q-F7 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

A bullet went into Dorian Noamorax's chest just under the heart at Q-F7. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Emil "Spark" Jmto of the Concord (@_jmto_). Dorian Noamorax was hit at Q-F7 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Emil "Spark" Jmto of the Concord (@_jmto_).

Isidor "Mole" Noamorax arrived carrying the family name of Dorian Noamorax. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Isidor "Mole" Noamorax wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Isidor "Mole" Noamorax. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
Isidor "Mole" Noamorax saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Isidor "Mole" Noamorax closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Isidor "Mole" Noamorax pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.

The Concord raiders came over at Q-F7 in the middle of the night. Isidor "Mole" Noamorax met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Emil Lutheranapol of the Concord (@lutheranapologist).
A letter came with Valentin Noamorax: "I am Isidor "Mole" Noamorax's cousin. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Valentin Noamorax was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.
royce.abapo: On Day 10 Valentin Abapo took a post at P-F14 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He sleeps with his boots on, and the men liked him for it.

Valentin Abapo of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Henrik "Spark" Emmanuelgome kept the tin. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Valentin Abapo looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A round went through the rim of Valentin Abapo's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Norbert Kuty of the Hegemony (@michael.kuty).
Valentin Abapo is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
Valentin Abapo counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.

Valentin Abapo reached up to fix a sandbag at P-F14 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Henrik "Parson" Ruthenianfas of the Hegemony (@great_ruthenianfascist).
The medics cleaned Valentin Abapo's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at P-F14.
Valentin Abapo hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
sam_mstk13: Nobody saw Karel Mstk arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in Q-F7, and a quiet machine gunner under it.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Karel Mstk stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Karel Mstk fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Matthias Bmiller, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything. A bullet hit Karel Mstk in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at Q-F7. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Henrik Houghton of the Hegemony (@patrick.houghton.5602). From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Karel Mstk wrote to a teacher who said he would amount to nothing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
No bed for Karel Mstk yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
Karel Mstk healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
The wind tore a sheet of corrugated iron off the dugout roof at Q-F7. Karel Mstk chased it halfway down the communication trench.

Karel Mstk had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Henrik Houghton was grazed. A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Karel Mstk shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Karel Pasoslargos, was badly wounded.
The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Karel Mstk offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once.
Across from Q-F7, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Karel Mstk saw it. Henrik Houghton was grazed.
